notes.title: Update #13
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 13[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8734984/6e985b7f1722958ec6abe3e171e571f026aba23a.gif[/img]

It's the Face POP update!  What is the face pop update exactly?  It's just an ADORABLE way for me to say I made the game slightly harder by adding a 5 round limit on faces in game.  See below!

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
    [*]I Added a 5-round limit to faces.  If you wear a face for more than 5 rounds in a row it blows up and you're back to having no face.  This is to keep the gameplay balanced whether you find a "strong" face in an early round or late. 
    [*]You have a couple second invincibility when you enter a room to keep you from getting hurt right when you walk in
[/list]

[b]Environment[/b]
[list]
    [*]I made the door to room13 much more defined and it displays how many keys you have found.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]The red hall elecrticity Killtrap has been fixed so that now it alternates between the two sets of killtraps.
    [*]Minor graphic fixes
    [*]A few more minor bug fixes.
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update 11 - BOSS BATTLES!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8734984/0b7fe74fb2e5f3297203fcc07e95abf7739b4c56.png[/img]
[h1]Update 11[/h1]

It's the BOSS BATTLES Update!  But it's so much more!  You can now change faces during gameplay.  Between rounds, various face crates will appear, that if selected will change your face to the face inside.  The only catch is you don't have a choice, once the box is opened your future fae is inside.  On the bright side, you'll get full life and the more faces you switch to in game, random, at times nonsensical tidbits of the storylinw will told.  This is also the last update before the full release (barring any gamebreaking bugs that need immediate attention)  You can still pick your start face in this beta, but thats more for testing the faces.  in the full version that won't be a part of the main game, but I might add it back in for some sort of Arcade Mode(?)  Back to the BOSS BATTLES!  You'll notice by every door there is now a light.  When the light is lit, that room is where a boss will be active in the next round.  This let's you run away from, or chase boss battles.  If you stay in the same room there is also a 1 in 12 chance that your current room will be the next boss battle, you just won't know it until it starts :)

Full update log below-

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added the 12 boss battles
    [*]You can pickup the boss face if you defeat them (12 new faces)
    [*]You can change your face in game `with face crates
    [*]3 Keys to open room 13 have been added (but you still can't open the door until the full release)
    [*]Each door has a light indicating next boss location if lit
    [*]You can now throw a melee weapon that you picked up at anytime when using a controller
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
    [*]Created a "ramp up"in the zombie activity in the early rounds
    [*]Adjusted the life amount of the faces to remove some advantages of faces that made the game too easy
    [*]The Magnetized face now has a timer
    [*]Lights out rounds are spaced out and a random occurances
[/list]

[b]Environment[/b]
[list]
    [*]Opened up room 3 a bit more to allow for better flow
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Minor graphic fixes
    [*]Flamethrower Killtraps now work
    [*]Objects that previously didn't now pause when paused
    [*]Player character can't fall trhough floor now
    [*]Enemies can't fall through floor now
    [*]many many......MANY more minor bug fixes.
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: SAVED GAME ISSUE WITH LATEST UPDATE
notes.notes:
It was brought to my attention this morning that when installing the latest update your game data is reset.  This was NOT supposed to happen and I apologize for the issue.  Even though this is Early Access and things like this happen, I still don't want players to feel like they wasted time unlocking features of the game just to have it wiped away.  I have found what caused the issue and will  make sure it doesn't happen again.  

Thankfully, because your stats are saved in the leaderboards, and unlocks in achievements, im working on a quick update that SHOULD pull down that information and reapply it to your current game.  My apologies for the issue, but feel free to keep playing as I'll make sure it adds your new kills to your previous mark as well :)

Until its uploaded the version has been bumped back to the previous update.

I'll let you know if there are any bumps with making this work but it will hopefully be up in the next day or so.

-Tony

notes.notes:
[img]http://cockyculture.com/misc/U3.png[/img]
It's update #3.

In this update I have made the initial zombies weaker and added a couple tiers of zombie toughness!  This should help everyone get off to a faster start, but the difficulty ramps up quickly!

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
    [*]Initial Zombies require a single shot to kill with basic ammo (2 shots with pellet)
    [*]New 3 tiers of zombies.  Basic, Middle, Strongest  with higher life per tier.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Zombies don't hurt you the instance you enter a room

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
This is the first, the original, the most important update.....so far.  Based on the initial feedback I got the biggest addition is the new ability to jump onto the stairs, jump up the stairs, and be able to fall onto the stairs.  

The way it works is similar to the way you jump through the stairwells and furniture, just hold down the jump button and you'll fall through, if you don't you land onto them.  I've also opened up the stairwells to make a little more room for the stair jumping.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Stair jumping
[*]Larger Stairwells
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
    [*]Player and zombies can no longer walk up/down beyond stairs
    [*]Player can no longer walk through the bottom floor
    [*]Slight pause before Kill traps begin
    [*]Room 1 Kill trap no longer hurts you before fully deployed
    [*]Health found between rounds no longer slides away
    [*]Room 7 Zombies don't climb up the side of the room
    [*]When using XBox controller aiming up is improved
[/list]

[b]Misc[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fog/Smoke comes in from side exits of rooms when open
    [*]Larger Stairwells
[/list]

Have a great weekend!
